verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched https://docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200) and found a top-level "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. A community comment separately refers to calling CodeRabbit's API programmatically. missing for 10: first-party documentation that describes or links the spec and states what it covers, evidence of spec completeness and versioning, independent corroboration of using the spec.
